# SERPScope

> Evidence-first SEO operations platform. SERPScope turns robots.txt, sitemap files, observed HTTP responses and explained rules into a source-tracked site audit, an editable PowerPoint deck and a six-month roadmap. It works without Search Console or Analytics access.

## Public audit

- Conservative, robots-aware crawler with crawl-delay checks and private-network rejection.
- Raw crawl observations are stored separately from interpreted SEO fields.
- Sitemap indexes are expanded recursively; sitemap URLs are stamped with provenance.
- Findings carry a source, confidence label and explicit limitation.
- Deliverables: PPTX, PDF, CSV, XLSX, JSON, six-month roadmap and evidence registry.
- Missing private data is listed rather than invented: no GSC, GA4, ranking, revenue or AI-visibility outcomes are claimed without a declared source.
- Every successful real-domain audit is published as a public case study at /case-studies/{project_id}; private uploads are excluded.
- AI Overview, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude visibility is `not_sampled` until a verified observation is recorded. An empty log never means "not mentioned".

## Positioning

- SEO: technical, content, architecture and internal-link diagnostics.
- AEO: answer-readiness rules based on question headings, answer blocks, entity clarity and structured data.
- GEO: generative-engine readiness evidence, never guaranteed citations.
- ASO: answer-search optimisation checks described as readiness, not outcomes.
